test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 08
subject: general
question: What was the objective of the Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993?

options.text: To constitute Human Rights Protection Commission
To establish Human Rights Protection Commission in the States

solution:
The correct answer is __**All of the above.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **main objective of the protection of the Human Rights Act 1993 is to guard human beings from violations.**
 
• Without Human rights, there would be** either no if or an incoherent life.**
 
• The rights relating to** life, liberty equality, and dignity** of the individual as persuaded by the constitution are also included in the category of** “Human Rights”.**
 
• **Human Rights are the rights and freedoms of all human beings.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The** objective of securing human rights as such is to confer protection to these rights against the abuse of power committed by the organs of state to establish an institution for the promotion of living condition beings and for the evolution of their personality and at the same time to provide effective remedial measures for obtaining redress in the event of those rights are violated.**
 
• The Act provides for the institution of the **National Human Rights Commission, State Human Rights Commission, and Human Rights Courts** which **seeks to prevent and punish any gross violation of human rights.**
